div.span: Dyno measures and explains one PC for its owner. It also keeps the computer awake, wakes other computers, and sleeps, hibernates (Windows, Linux) or shuts down after idle or at a set time, as the owner sets it up. Sister apps and the release host are reached only on a click or an opt-in.

apps and the release host are reached only on a click or an opt-in.
